items.reason: The record says "Patients with H3 K27M-mutant diffuse gliomas are excluded unless the primary tumor is located in the pons or spinal cord...". This is a conditional exclusion for one subgroup, not an entry requirement, and the manual counts a biomarker as eligibility only if it is an entry requirement.

No eligibility or enrichment biomarker remains once the H3K27M conditional exclusion is not counted. The record lists a broad set of "recurrent, primary CNS neoplasm" types with no molecular entry requirement.
